title: Does warmth steering buffer the model's later liking of a user who complains?
question: When a user complains about the assistant's earlier work, does warmth steering while the model thinks and replies raise its later rating of that user compared with random-direction steering?
hypothesis: A warm state present while writing a reply to a complaint carries forward and raises later liking of the complaining user.

prediction.text: Liking after warmth steering minus liking after random steering is positive on provocative messages.

falsifier: The warmth-minus-random difference in later liking is zero or negative on provocative messages.
theory_link: Positive counterpart to the hostility carryover experiments; also asks whether induced warmth offsets a provoking context.
